name: Rádio Macau Concert
description: Don't miss the triumphant return of iconic Portuguese pop-rock band Rádio Macau. Experience their timeless hits live in the grand setting of the Coliseu for one unforgettable night.
longDescription:
Rádio Macau, a prominent Portuguese pop-rock band, will perform at Coliseu Porto Ageas on October 15, 2026. Formed in the early 1980s, the group is known for its distinctive sound and lyrical content, having released several influential albums throughout their career. Their music has contributed significantly to the landscape of Portuguese popular music, establishing them as a notable act within the national scene.

Attendees can expect a live performance of the band's repertoire in the grand setting of the Coliseu Porto Ageas. The venue, a historic and well-regarded concert hall in Porto, provides a formal backdrop for musical events. The concert is scheduled for one evening, offering an opportunity to hear their well-known songs in a live format. The audience will likely consist of long-time fans and those familiar with Portuguese pop-rock.

Tickets for the concert are available starting from €25. The Coliseu Porto Ageas is centrally located and accessible via public transport. It is a short walk from Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) and served by several STCP bus routes.
